name: Zoran Kovačić
bio:
Zoran's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly while studying mechanical engineering at the University of Zagreb. A chance encounter with a local karting team needing aerodynamic assistance ignited a passion that would define his career. He quickly realized that manipulating airflow could be as much an art as a science.

After honing his skills in Formula Renault, Zoran joined Kart Academy, drawn to their dedication to nurturing young talent. He believes in a holistic approach to aero development, emphasizing the importance of driver feedback and track data analysis. His detail-oriented nature and knack for identifying subtle performance gains have made him a valuable asset to the team. Zoran is known for his ability to adapt to changing regulations and resources, consistently finding innovative solutions to maximize performance, even with limited budgets.

What sets Zoran apart is his unwavering loyalty and dedication to his craft. He thrives in an independent environment, often working late into the night to refine his designs. While he may not be the most vocal member of the team, his meticulous approach and unwavering commitment to excellence are evident in the performance of the karts he helps shape.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: A man of medium build with a thoughtful expression etched on his face.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with aerodynamic sketches.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
